name: Stewing Beef Casserole
description: A hearty beef casserole with vegetables, slow-cooked at a low temperature for tender results.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients lightly in a bowl.
Transfer the mixture to a casserole dish or roasting pan and cover tightly.
Bake at 250°F for 4 hours without uncovering.

keywords: beef casserole, slow-cooked stew, comfort food

_similar.name: Beef and Rice Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole featuring ground beef, sautéed celery and onion, and cooked rice, all baked in a tomato soup sauce.

recipeInstructions.text: Sauté celery and onion in butter until soft and tender.
Place rice in a greased 1½ quart casserole dish.
Top the rice with the celery mixture.
Season the ground beef with salt and pepper, then cook in a skillet until browned.
Arrange the cooked beef on top of the celery mixture.
Combine the tomato soup with water and pour over the meat layer.
Bake in a preheated 325°F oven for ½ hour.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, rice casserole, comfort food

_similar.name: Meat and Potato Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty casserole with ground beef, sliced potatoes, and corn, topped with a savory gravy.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef with onion and garlic. Season with salt and pepper.
Layer sliced potatoes in an 8L casserole dish.
Mix the gravy mix with 1 cup water and pour over the potatoes. Add remaining water.
Top with corn and the browned meat mixture.
Cover and cook at 350°F for 50 minutes.

_similar.keywords: meat casserole, potato and corn dish, gravy topping

_similar.name: Meatball Pasta Stew
_similar.description: A savory stew with homemade meatballs, pasta, and a rich tomato-based sauce.
recipeIngredient: ¼ to ⅛ cup dry bread crumbs

recipeInstructions.text: Combine hamburger, egg, bread crumbs, onion, salt, mustard, and pepper to make meatballs. Shape into 1-inch balls.
Place meatballs on a greased baking sheet and bake at 350°F for 10 to 15 minutes, or until browned.
In a large pot, cook onion and garlic until tender.
Add flour and stir constantly for 1 minute.
Gradually add beef broth, stirring constantly until boiling.
Add tomato paste, undrained tomatoes, bay leaf, and thyme. Mix well.
Add meatballs, carrots, zucchini, peppers, and parsley. Simmer for 40 minutes.
Add cooked pasta and heat until hot.
Remove bay leaf before serving.

_similar.keywords: meatball stew, pasta stew, tomato-based sauce

_similar.name: Creamy Beef and Potato Bake
_similar.description: A layered casserole featuring ground beef, potatoes, zucchini, and a creamy cheddar sauce.
recipeIngredient: ½ cup prepared tomato pasta sauce

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F to 375°F.
In a skillet, melt 2 tablespoons butter and oil over medium-low heat. Add potatoes and cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently.
Add zucchini, salt, and pepper to the skillet. Cook until zucchini is tender.
Spoon the vegetable mixture into a 13x9 inch baking dish. Set aside.
In the same skillet, cook onion and Italian seasoning until onion is tender.
Add ground beef to the skillet and cook until it loses its pink color. Stir in tomato sauce and ½ cup milk.
Spoon the meat mixture over the vegetable layer in the baking dish.
Melt remaining butter in the skillet, stir in flour, and cook for 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in remaining milk. Cook and stir until the sauce thickens.
Stir in cheddar cheese until melted. Pour the sauce over the meat layer.
Bake at 350°F for 20 to 25 minutes.
Let stand for 10 minutes before serving.

_similar.keywords: beef casserole, potato bake, creamy sauce

_similar.name: Barley and Corn Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty barley casserole with corn, carrots, and garlic, perfect as a comforting side dish.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a heavy casserole. Cook onion, garlic, and carrots until the onion is softened, stirring frequently.
Stir in barley and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Pour in vegetable stock, cover, and bake at 350 °F for 1 hour.
Test that barley is tender. Stir in corn and parsley.
Return to the oven to heat through. Season with pepper to taste.

_similar.keywords: barley casserole, corn, carrots, comforting side dish
